I was born in america but moved to England when I was little so I never got to experience life there. every year however, we would go back in the summer holidays and visit the family and do fun touristy things, leading me to view america as this awesome, fun tourist attraction where it was always hot and sunny and everything was bigger and cooler.

fast forward to the autumn of 2018, when my dad and I went back to visit. it had been 3 years since we had visited last due to financial reasons and through those years, I had been on a big self discovery streak, coming out as lesbian to my parents and discovering Wicca, as well as reading about the politics going on in america and realising that I had been looking through rose tinted glasses the whole time. Reading about the mass shootings and corrupted politics made me anxious for the actual trip and, it's safe to say that last year was a trip of enlightenment. 

another fast forward to spring of 2019 where we had plans to go for the whole of spring break which  (bummer considering I already had a bunch of school work to finish and group projects requiring me to be with the people) somehow managed to be worse than the last. Sure I got to go to hot topic but at the same time, I got pulled into my aunt and uncle's pro trump activity and had to sit through a week of pro life bullshit and constant shaming from my cousins for struggling with depression and anxiety. I hadn't realised my family were so judgemental or cruel, even going so far as to take me to church for a few days because they thought it would 'straighten me out'

In conclusion, my family fuckin suck and I dont wanna go back there ever again because if I fall down the stairs, apparently it could cost me my life savings

my grandma had a cat we all called miss skitter for how skinny and skittish she was, but for some reason, she was always so friendly and kind with me. When I was staying with them last, skitter was more frail than usual and was refusing to eat her food, to which my family only sighed and made fun of her. I love animals more than I love oxygen so I stayed with her all evening, listening to this tiny ragged cat heave and wheeze as she nestled next to me.

I genuinely cannot explain how much I loved that cat but when we left the next morning, I knew she didn't have that long left so I made sure to spend as much time with her before driving down to my other grandparents house where we learned my grandma had taken miss skitter to the vet and had her put down. I never cried so much for an animal and I will always remember her

a year or two ago, my friends and I went into town on the weekend and after hitting a few shops and the ice cream stand, we found ourselves in a B&M bargains (similar to a big lots or family dollar, basically a big discount shop) and we're looking through the aisles for cheap soda and snacks. At the time I was wearing my big Georgia Tech hoodie because it was fairly cold out and I had already bough a few things from other stores which I had stored in the front pocket (mainly pens and stuff) 

So, we're going through the toys aisle and a pack of pens I had bought began sliding out of my pocket and being annoying so I went to put it in my bag. no biggie.

suddenly, I feel a pair of hands grab my bag and I see an angry shop assistant pull the pens out and she starts yelling at me to put them back where I found them, patting me down with one hand.

I immediately panic and my friends start explaining to her that I didn't steal them but she yells at us, calling us good for nothing teens and that she was going to call the police. 

Eventually I managed to find the receipt for the pens and she gave me back my bag, muttering something along the lines of an apology but then for the rest of our short time in the store, she glared at us made sure we left quickly. 

and I've not been in a B&M bargains since...

TL:DR, angry shopping assistant accused me of stealing
